title: Grow Your Fleet Contracting with J.B. Hunt
summary: Fleet owners, grow your business, secure consistent freight and access technology and support with J.B. Hunt’s owner operator opportunities for fleets.
body_markdown:
If you are a fleet owner looking for ways to grow your business, secure consistent freight and access exclusive discounts and support, look no further than J.B. Hunt contracting opportunities for fleets.


Your business, your fleet and your earning potential, backed by access to J.B. Hunt's advantages, technology and reputation. It pays to do business with a company that is Driven for You™.


Here are four reasons operating your fleet under our authority could be a smart move for your fleet.


## 1. Consistent Freight


One of the biggest challenges for fleet owners is finding steady loads. With J.B. Hunt, you can tap into one of the largest freight networks in North America, strengthened by access to major shippers. This means:


- Dependable freight availability
- Less downtime for your trucks
- A more predictable income for your business


## 2. Discounts and Advantages


[Access to exclusive discounts](https://owneroperators.jbhunt.com/advantages) on fuel, tires, maintenance and insurance offered by third-party vendors to owner operators contracting with J.B. Hunt can make a big impact on fleet owners. Advantages like our fuel surcharge pass downs and 35% off Goodyear tires help offset costs, lower operating costs and keep more money in the hands of your fleet.


### Take your fleet to the next level.


Call Us


## 3. Advanced Technology


J.B. Hunt’s advanced technology gives fleet owners the tools to run their business smarter and more efficiently. Our[DRIVE App](https://drivers.jbhunt.com/blog/why-drive-with-j-b-hunt/drive-easy-with-the-j-b-hunt-drive-app) puts control in your hands with an[easy-to-use load board](https://owneroperators.jbhunt.com/blog/advantages-and-discounts/jb-hunt-load-board-for-owner-operators) , allowing you to search, select and book loads instantly—no forced dispatch, no waiting for approval.


Features like advanced load matching help minimize empty miles and maximize revenue, while tools such as[Find an Asset](https://owneroperators.jbhunt.com/blog/advantages-and-discounts/jb-hunt-find-an-asset) streamline trailer location and reduce downtime. Combined with real-time visibility and planning capabilities, our technology empowers fleet owners to stay productive and profitable.


## 4. Flexibility and Control


When you contract your fleet with J.B. Hunt, you maintain full ownership and control of your business. You choose how you operate, who you hire and how you grow, while leveraging the scale, reputation and support of a trusted industry leader that allows you access to resources that make running your fleet easier. J.B. Hunt gives you the tools to succeed without sacrificing independence.


### Ready to Take Your Fleet Further?


Owning a fleet is about independence, growth, and profitability, and J.B. Hunt can support you as you reach your business goals. Gain access to freight, tools and support that make doing business better.
